facts.fact: 离开 Lucy 公寓已近三个小时。
facts.anchor: It’s been nearly three hours since I left Lucy’s apartment

facts.fact: 听到"死"这个字，他身上就响起巴甫洛夫式的反应。
facts.anchor: Hearing the word died elicits a Pavlovian response in me.

facts.fact: Agency 要他填的表单题目。
facts.anchor: In no more than five sentences, please describe how Lucy McKenzie reacts to surprises.

facts.fact: 他决定把自习室里的两个男孩吓走。
facts.anchor: I decide to frighten them into leaving.

facts.fact: 他在表格里记下 Lucy 受惊时高高扬起的眉毛。
facts.anchor: Lucy’s eyebrows rise so high they nearly meet her hairline.

facts.fact: 表格不按时交回，就有地狱来找麻烦。
facts.anchor: there will be Hell to pay
